title: Tiny, cute camera
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- camera body -->
  <rect x="18" y="36" width="64" height="42" rx="9" fill="#4a90d9"/>
  <rect x="18" y="36" width="64" height="42" rx="9" fill="none" stroke="#6ab0f5" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <rect x="22" y="40" width="56" height="10" rx="5" fill="#6ab0f5" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- top bump / viewfinder area -->
  <rect x="30" y="28" width="24" height="12" rx="4" fill="#3a7bc8"/>
  <rect x="30" y="28" width="24" height="12" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#6ab0f5" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- flash -->
  <rect x="60" y="30" width="14" height="9" rx="2" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <rect x="60" y="30" width="14" height="9" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#fff5b0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- lens outer ring -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="58" r="17" fill="#2e6bb0"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="58" r="17" fill="none" stroke="#6ab0f5" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- lens middle ring -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="58" r="12" fill="#1a4a85"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="58" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#5a9ee0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- lens glass -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="58" r="7.5" fill="#0f3057"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="58" r="7.5" fill="none" stroke="#4a90d9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="55" r="2.8" fill="#a8d4ff" opacity="0.85"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="61" r="1.2" fill="#7ab8f0" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- little red record dot -->
  <circle cx="74" cy="44" r="3" fill="#ff5a5a"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="44" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#ff9a9a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- shutter button -->
  <rect x="64" y="22" width="9" height="7" rx="2.5" fill="#ff8a8a"/>
  <rect x="64" y="22" width="9" height="7" rx="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#ffb8b8" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <!-- cute little feet -->
  <rect x="30" y="78" width="12" height="6" rx="3" fill="#3a7bc8"/>
  <rect x="58" y="78" width="12" height="6" rx="3" fill="#3a7bc8"/>
  <!-- strap loops -->
  <rect x="19" y="44" width="5" height="10" rx="2.5" fill="#6ab0f5"/>
  <rect x="76" y="44" width="5" height="10" rx="2.5" fill="#6ab0f5"/>
</svg>
